name: Classic Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a loaf pan.
In a large bowl, mash the ripe bananas.
Stir in the melted butter, baking soda, and salt.
Add the sugar, beaten egg, and vanilla extract. Mix well.
Gradually fold in the flour until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan.
Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let cool in the pan for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Easy Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into strips
instructions: In a bowl, toss the chicken strips with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add bell peppers and onion to the skillet and cook until slightly tender.
Add broccoli florets, garlic, and ginger. Stir-fry for a few minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet.
Pour in the stir-fry sauce and cook until heated through and the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.

name: Creamy Tomato Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, oregano, and basil.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Use an immersion blender or carefully transfer the soup to a regular blender and blend until smooth.
Return the soup to the pot. Stir in heavy cream (if using) and heat through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot with grilled cheese or crusty bread.

name: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease baking sheets or line with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
Stir in the chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto the prepared baking sheets.
Bake for 9-11 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are still slightly soft.
Let cool on the baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Simple Avocado Toast
ingredients: 2 slices of bread (sourdough, whole wheat, etc.)
Optional toppings: red pepper flakes, everything bagel seasoning, lime juice, a fried egg
instructions: Toast the bread to your desired level of crispness.
While the bread is toasting, mash the avocado in a small bowl with a fork.
Season the mashed avocado with salt and pepper to taste.
Spread the mashed avocado evenly over the toasted bread.
Add any optional toppings you desire and serve immediately.

name: Easy Ground Beef Tacos
ingredients: Optional toppings: shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, sour cream, salsa
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium heat. Drain off any excess grease.
Stir in the taco seasoning and water. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5-10 minutes, or until the liquid has reduced.
Warm the tortillas according to package directions (microwave, oven, or skillet).
Fill each tortilla with the seasoned ground beef.
Top with your favorite toppings and serve immediately.
